content.title: McNeese State University
content.text: McNeese State University (McNeese) is a student-centered institution dedicated to providing high-quality education that transforms lives. With strong ties to regional employers and a deep connection to community needs, McNeese prepares graduates to lead, contribute, and thrive in southwest Louisiana and beyond. Founded in 1939, McNeese is a cornerstone of southwest Louisiana, driving regional prosperity and earning national recognition for academic excellence and return on investment. Known for producing career-ready graduates, McNeese consistently ranks among the top public universities in the South. Students can choose from over 100 market-driven academic programs across the College of Business, Burton College of Education, College of Engineering and Sciences, College of Liberal Arts, and College of Nursing and Health Professions, preparing them to lead, serve, and succeed. at a Glance McNeese’s Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) program trains advanced practitioners in psychiatric mental health nursing Business and engineering students can earn a Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) certificate through the College of Business McNeese’s three working farms give students hands-on experience in livestock and crop production Consistently ranked among the South’s top regional universities by the U.S. News & World Report Quick Links AdmissionsAlumniAthleticsFinancial Aid and ScholarshipsResidential LifeStudent LifeCareersNewsMSU SP 2026-2030Visit the McNeese State University Website
